by: Stoneware, Ghost, Froststeel, Akhedian Steel, Clay censers
pur: Deals 80% dexterity damage to units in the area.

inh: Removes 4 Poison. If this unit is not affected by Poison, recovers 5% of their Health.
pur: Gives as many Toxic Miasmas as this unit has Inhalations to units in the area.
Applies Weakening to units in the area. If 2 or more Inhalations were consumed, also applies Vulnerability.

inh: Any unit dealing melee damage to this unit gets 2 Fevers per Inhalation.
pur: Applies 2 Fevers to units in the area. If 2 or more Inhalations were consumed, applies 2 extra Fevers for each debuff on the target.
Deals 60-80% dexterity damage for each Inhalation to targets in the area and to enemy units adjacent to them.
Applies Relentless to allies engaged in the area. If 2 Inhalations or more were consumed, also applies Weakening to enemies in the area.

inh: Gives as many Invigorating Smokes as this unit has Inhalations.
pur: Heals allies in the area for 10% of their maximum Health for each Inhalation consumed.
Deals 80% dexterity damage to enemies in the area and applies as many Rage to allies in the area as there are applications on this unit.
